title: Preparing Right of Way
description: Preparing right of way by clearing, grubbing, removing, and disposing of trees, brush, and obstructions.

title: Removing Concrete
description: Breaking, removing, and disposing of existing concrete pavement, curb, gutter, sidewalks, or structures.

title: Removing Treated & Untreated Base & Asphalt Pavement
description: Removing existing flexible base, treated base, or asphalt concrete pavement.

title: Obliterating Abandoned Road
description: Obliterating abandoned roadways, backfilling ditches, and restoring ground surface.

title: Excavation
description: Excavating roadway, channels, and structural foundations, including haul and disposal.

title: Subgrade Widening
description: Excavating and preparing roadbed widening for subgrade layers.

title: Embankment
description: Constructing roadway embankments using suitable earth, rock, or approved materials.

title: Backfilling Pavement Edges
description: Backfilling edges of pavement using flexible base, topsoil, or select material.

title: Blading
description: Blading and shaping slopes, shoulders, ditches, or subgrade with motor grader.

title: Topsoil
description: Furnishing and placing topsoil for vegetation growth and slope stabilization.

description: Furnishing and applying compost manufactured topsoil or compost erosion control blankets.

title: Sodding for Erosion Control

title: Seeding for Erosion Control
